corrections.originalIssue: Historical hanging-object stop could be mistaken for current Illinois stop authority.
corrections.verifiedFact: Public Act 103-0032, effective January 1, 2024, added 625 ILCS 5/12-503(c-5), prohibiting a stop/search solely for that front-windshield-object violation or suspected violation. This is later legislation, not a judicial reversal of Lomeli.
corrections.pinpoint: Opinion paragraphs 3-6, 9-16, 18-19; Public Act amendment to section 12-503; State Police HB2389/P.A.103-0032 entry
corrections.resolution: Owner added subsequentLegislation field and historical-law caveat; independently confirmed in current ledger.

caseChecks.policyReason: Agenda-limited public-comment rules are not presidential power or political censorship generally.

caseChecks.policyReason: Established residency and abandonment for one candidate do not establish support for the beneficiary's party or a position on Trump eligibility.

publicStatementCheck.finding: Primary interview independently read and attribution/date confirmed. Her comment about courts during the Trump years can be presented as a dated public statement with its transgender-rights/judicial-remedies context. It is not a specific holding or proof of her current positions on every Trump policy. No inference from personal identity is permitted.
publicStatementCheck.publicationRule: Separate public statements from judicial holdings and case policy comparisons; limit direct quotation to the short verified excerpt.

conclusion: No affirmative party/Trump policy-overlap label is justified by these 25 selected case groups against the reviewed precise baselines. Concrete limited similarities and differences are supplied for three firearm cases, with timing and later-treatment qualifications. The verified legal outcomes remain useful public information. This conclusion does not infer ideological neutrality or personal beliefs.
